svg.title: Octopus barista at an espresso machine
svg.desc: Front three-quarter view of a coral octopus working behind a wooden coffee-shop counter. All eight tentacles are separate and visible: one grips the portafilter below the espresso machine, one holds a milk pitcher and pours a continuous stream into a cup standing on a digital scale on the countertop, one presses a button on the machine panel, one extends straight out to point at the wall clock, and four more drape over the counter and curl in the air.

g.data-role: tentacle 1 - points at the wall clock
tentacle 2 - presses the espresso machine button
tentacle 4 - free, resting along the counter
tentacle 5 - holds the pitcher and pours milk
tentacle 7 - free, drapes over the counter edge
tentacle 8 - free, drapes over the counter edge
